summary: Stabilized release with onboarding state checks, UI button label refinements, and enhanced Security Center options.

changes.text: Enforced cryptographic master password verification across all vault password input forms.
Added support for encrypted file attachments across Financial, Legal, and Personal vault compartments.
Resolved onboarding state persistence check to route incomplete setups directly to onboarding.
Updated release download URLs and badges to version v1.1.30.

knownIssues: Hardware biometrics integration currently requires manual SafeStorage entitlement configuration on some Linux distros.

summary: Full layout refactor, 24-word recovery phrase grid, dark theme selector, and automated CI/CD workflow build.

changes.text: Integrated 4 dark themes: Pure Black, Obsidian Gold, Cyber Emerald, and Midnight Sapphire.
Added Panic Lock button and Ctrl+Shift+L global keyboard shortcut.
Eliminated startup splash screen animation hang with defensive pointer event handling.
Automated GitHub Actions installer package builds for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

knownIssues: Initial setup onboarding greeting modal can briefly flash prior to JavaScript view initialization.
